purpose: Reject unsuitable relational-execution families before training by requiring oracle and no-gradient evidence that support selection, argument-role execution, and fallback are correctly factored.

obligations.name: n0_breadth_preservation
obligations.requirement: Relational execution remains a composable N0 capability and does not replace semantic, structured, fusion, latent, or later identity systems with narrow KG-QA logic.

obligations.name: oracle_support_closure
obligations.requirement: With correct relational support supplied, the executor can solve source/target role reversals without using the old parent global field scorer as the answer mechanism.

obligations.name: oracle_role_closure
obligations.requirement: With relevant support and requested argument role supplied, source/target behavior remains separable across every relation family.

obligations.name: no_global_competition_leak
obligations.requirement: Fields excluded from valid relational support cannot defeat the relational result solely through the old parent global softmax.

obligations.name: adaptive_support_cardinality
obligations.requirement: One architecture supports zero, one, or many relevant fields/edges and does not encode fixed top-k as a permanent capability rule.

obligations.name: ambiguity_preservation
obligations.requirement: Multiple genuinely co-valid supports may remain active without forced arbitrary singleton collapse.

obligations.name: compositional_path_execution
obligations.requirement: Ordered multi-edge relation chains are representable and noncommutative relation order remains distinguishable.

obligations.name: explicit_role_intervention
obligations.requirement: Changing only requested argument role on otherwise identical query/evidence produces the corresponding source/target execution change.

obligations.name: relation_intervention
obligations.requirement: Changing only relation semantics with endpoints fixed affects execution when relation meaning requires it.

obligations.name: endpoint_intervention
obligations.requirement: Changing endpoint content with query/relation fixed affects execution when endpoint identity matters.

obligations.name: permutation_equivariance
obligations.requirement: Reordering unordered fields/edges does not change semantic result.

obligations.name: provenance_reliability_causality
obligations.requirement: Provenance/reliability affects execution only where behaviorally relevant and remains inspectable.

obligations.name: parent_fallback_isolation
obligations.requirement: Non-relational examples may defer to the general parent without relational side effects; fallback is not the edge-identity mechanism.

obligations.name: representation_sufficiency_before_gradient
obligations.requirement: Required query operator, relation, field/edge, and role information is recoverable at executor inputs before training is authorized.

obligations.name: fresh_generalization
obligations.requirement: TRAIN/DEV/TEST lexical templates, subjects/entities, attributes, and query framing are split sufficiently to block phrase memorization.

obligations.name: identity_neutrality
obligations.requirement: N0 uses no private Elaina identity gradient.

obligations.name: no_permanent_capacity_ceiling
obligations.requirement: Test-time field count, edge count, support size, relation vocabulary, hop count, layer count, or compute budget is not reinterpreted as a permanent product capability ceiling.

candidate_families.name: schema_anchored_continuous_relational_executor
inspirations: explicit relation/role codes without rigid final symbolic parser

candidate_families.name: evidence_justified_hybrid
inspirations: continuous operator anchoring for role composition
candidate_families.restriction: Every mechanism must correspond to a proven failure boundary; mechanism accumulation by itself is not justification.
